cd /workspace/tmp && which ps; cat > res.py <<'EOF'
import subprocess, resource, time, sys, os
data = open('/workspace/tmp/multi.jsonl','rb').read()
t0=time.time()
r = subprocess.run(['/workspace/submission/run.sh'], input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/')
el=time.time()-t0

EOF
timeout 120 python3 res.py; ps -eLf 2>/dev/null | wc -l; ls /proc/self/task | wc -l
